_fixture_meta.expected_failure: Namespace defense: vendor_id is part of the idempotency UNIQUE so an id collision across vendors NEVER causes a shadow-write or shadow-read.

binding_keys._comment: Same vendor_entity_id under vendor_id=libro already exists in libro_reservations_fixture.dart for the same operator. Sink uses (vendor_id, operator_id, vendor_entity_id, vendor_modified_at) as the upsert key — adding vendor_id segregates the namespace.

what_must_NOT_happen: OpenTable webhook MUST NOT shadow-update the Libro row.
OpenTable webhook MUST NOT shadow-read the Libro row's vendor_modified_at and skip its own write as a duplicate.
The framework's inbound_webhook_idempotency UNIQUE on (vendor_id, operator_id, vendor_event_id) MUST allow this OpenTable event to land alongside any Libro event with the same string id.
